# The cheap unit tests: the files a pull request runs by default, alongside
# Ruff and the `--fast` suite (see "Plan the run" in workflows/test.yaml).
#
# A file belongs here when it renders nothing, compiles no kernel, and needs
# neither LaTeX nor a system ffmpeg (the cheap scope installs neither), so the
# whole list runs in well under a minute from a cold cache. Measured when this
# list was made: 787 tests in 18 s on a 4-core Linux container with an empty
# ~/.algan/cache. Anything that renders stays out; it runs in the full suite,
# which a pull request gets with the `full-ci` label and master gets on every
# push.
#
# One path per line, relative to the repository root. A path that does not
# exist on the branch under test is skipped rather than failing the run, so a
# file can be listed before the pull request that adds it is merged.
